tweetText: Major tech companies like Meta and Microsoft are calling for US policymakers to protect open-weight AI models. This support ensures developers can access and build upon powerful AI technology openly. via AI News
OpenAI is adding a feature to ChatGPT that lets users connect their medical records and Apple Health data. This makes it easier to use AI for managing personal health information. via AI News

OpenAI is launching a new service that bundles AI agents with hands-on support from its own engineers. This ensures large companies can successfully deploy complex AI tools rather than struggling with self-service setups. via AI News
OpenAI released a new AI-powered keypad designed to assist with coding. It could change how developers write software by streamlining complex tasks. via TechCrunch AI
New AI lab Prentis is reportedly raising $100M. They aim to automate routine computer tasks to move beyond simple coding. via TechCrunch AI
Cognition bought Poke to give its AI coder, Devin, a better personality. This shows that how an AI interacts with people is now just as important as its technical skills. via TechCrunch AI
Anthropic launched Opus 5. It is cheaper and less restrictive than Fable, making it a better choice for most users. via TechCrunch AI
AI companies are urging US officials to avoid broad restrictions on open-weight models. This could prevent innovation and limit competition in the global AI race. via TechCrunch AI
Bluesky’s AI assistant Attie can now search news and trends across the AT Protocol. This turns social data into a powerful tool for researchers. via TechCrunch AI
